blocks.content: The Commission consists of a Chief Information Commissioner and not more than ten Information Commissioners.

rows: Eligible to be appointed as CIC, but total aggregate tenure cannot exceed 5 years

items: CIC is a Statutory Body created under the Right to Information Act, 2005, NOT a Constitutional Body.
The Selection Committee includes the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, NOT the Rajya Sabha.
Information Commissioners are not eligible for reappointment to the same post.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Information Commission consists of a Chief Information Commissioner and not more than ten Information Commissioners.

Members are appointed by the President on the recommendation of a three-member committee comprising the Prime Minister, the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
Candidates must be persons of eminence in public life with experience in law, science, technology, social service, management, journalism, mass media, or administration.
Commissioners cannot be Members of Parliament or State Legislature, nor can they hold any office of profit or pursue any business or profession.
Members are not eligible for reappointment after completing their tenure.
